# AI Tool Hub

> Curated, hand-tested reviews of the best AI tools. Updated weekly. Real reviews, no pay-to-play.

## About

AI Tool Hub is an independent directory of 16+ AI tools across 20 categories, with 19 head-to-head comparisons and 15+ long-form guides. Every tool is tested hands-on by a practitioner for at least 2 weeks before being listed. The team is small (5 people), independent, and editorially transparent.

## Coverage

- 16 AI tools with in-depth reviews (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Leonardo.AI, Sora, Runway, ElevenLabs, Suno, Descript, Notion AI, Perplexity, Jasper)
- 19 head-to-head comparison pages (ChatGPT vs Claude, Midjourney vs SD, Cursor vs Copilot, etc.)
- 20 curated categories (best AI writing tools, best image generators, etc.)
- 15+ long-form guides (best free AI tools for students, ChatGPT vs Claude, etc.)

## Editorial standards

- No pay-to-play rankings
- No AI-generated reviews
- Every review is signed by the human who wrote it
- Re-testing every 6 months
- Affiliate links disclosed in the privacy policy and on relevant pages
- 5-dimension rubric: output quality, ease of use, pricing transparency, support, privacy
- Tools scoring below 6.0 on any dimension are excluded

## Categories

- AI Writing Tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Jasper)
- AI Image Generators (Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Leonardo.AI)
- AI Coding Tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot)
- AI Video Generators (Sora, Runway)
- AI Audio Tools (ElevenLabs, Suno, Descript)
- AI Productivity Tools (Notion AI, Perplexity)

## Pricing disclosure

We display ads via Google AdSense. We have a small number of affiliate links (ElevenLabs, Hostinger). Affiliate links never influence our rankings.
